blockingIssues.problem: The idea asserts that numbered lockers caused the fall in lost-item reports; the source does not support a causal attribution and explicitly notes other simultaneous changes.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: “Six stations tried numbered lockers in July; lost-item reports fell from 18 to 11. Staffing and opening hours also changed. The note does not isolate a cause.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The source does not provide evidence isolating numbered lockers as the cause of the reduction in lost-item reports.
